newsitem.title: INDIA: No plans to phase out models-Mercedes-Benz India.
newsitem.headline: No plans to phase out models-Mercedes-Benz India.

text.p: Mercedes-Benz India Ltd (MBIL) has denied newspaper reports that it planned to phase out the models it has been marketing in India.

"The joint venture launched E220 (petrol) and E250D (diesel), highly successful models of the Mercedes-Benz E-Class range in India and these models will continue," the company said in a statement late on Monday.
"While MBIL, like all other automobile companies, continues to review its model policy, there is no plan to phase out these tried and proven models in the immediate future," it said.
MBIL said Daimler Benz AG did not plan to raise its 51 percent holding in the firm. Tata Engineering and Locomotive Company (TELCO) owns the remaining 49 percent.
MBIL has sold over 1,500 cars after commercial sale began in January 1996, it said.
